questions.question:
**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The invigilator is advising the students not to carry calculators into the examination hall.

options.text: The students are being advised by the invigilator not to carry calculators into the examination hall.
The students have been advised not to carry calculators into the examination hall by the invigilator.
The students were advised not to carry calculators into the examination hall
The students were advised the invigilator not to carry calculators into the examination hall.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**The students are being advised by the invigilator not to carry calculators into the examination hall**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the present continuous tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into passive voice, the subject 'The invigilator' of the active voice becomes the object, the object '**the students**' becomes the subject.
 
• The active format "is + V1 (advise) + ing" should be converted into the passive format "are + being + V3 (**advised**)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present continuous tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Verbs of passive format have a different set of tenses (*V3 - Past participle or Third form of the Verb) as given below in the table:

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 TENSE
 ACTIVE
 PASSIVE
 PASSIVE CONVERSION
 
 

 Present Simple
 He plays football
 am/is/are + V3
 Football is played by him
 
 

 Present Continuous
 He is playing football
 am/is/are + being +V3
 Football is being played by him
 
 

 Present Perfect
 He has played football
 Has/have + been+ V3
 Football has been played by him
 
 

 Present Perfect Continuous
 He has been playing football
 Not used and unusual.
 Not used and unusual
 
 

 Past Simple
 He played football
 Was/were + V3
 Football was played by him
 
 

 Past Continuous
 He was playing football
 Was/were + being + V3
 Football was being played by him
 
 

 Past Perfect
 He had played football
 Had + been + V3
 Football had been played by him
 
 

 Past Perfect Continuous
 He had been playing football
 Not used and unusual
 Not used and unusual
 
 

 Future Simple
 He will play football
 Will + be + V3
 Football will be played by him
 
 

 Future Continuous
 He will be playing football
 Not used and unusual
 Not used and unusual
 
 

 Future Perfect
 He will have played football
 Will have been + V3
 Football will have been played by him
 
 

 Future Perfect Continuous
 He will have been playing football
 Not used and unusual
 Not used and unusual
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• Active Voice में , एक वाक्य विषय पर जोर देता है, एक क्रिया करता है।
 
• Passive Voice में , एक वाक्य वाक्य की क्रिया या वस्तु पर जोर देता है।
 
• दिया गया वाक्य active voice में है और यह present continuous tense में है।
 
• जब हम इस वाक्य को passive voice में बदलते हैं, तो active voice का subject 'The invigilator', object बन जाता है और object 'the students', subject बन जाता है।
 
• Active format "is + V1 (advise) + ing" को passive format "are + being + V3 (advised)" में परिवर्तित किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• यह present continuous tense के लिए active and passive voice rule है।

 

अतः सही उत्तर विकल्प 1 है।

questions.question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. But the eagle, in wrath, gave the beetle a flap of his wing, and straightaway seized upon the hare and devoured him.

B. The beetle, therefore, interceded with the eagle, begging of him not to kill the poor suppliant, and pleaded with him not to kill so small an animal.

C. When the eagle flew away, the beetle flew after him, to learn where his nest was.

D. A hare, being pursued by an eagle, took himself for refuge to the nest of a beetle, whom he begged to save him.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DBAC'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a hare". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
 
• Sentence B will come after D because it explains how the beetle requested or pleaded with the eagle to not kill the hare.
 
• Sentence A will come after B because it explains whether the eagle killed the hare or not.
 
• The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it explains **what the beetle has done finally when the eagle flew away**.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *A hare, being pursued by an eagle, took himself for refuge to the nest of a beetle, whom he begged to save him. The beetle, therefore, interceded with the eagle, begging of him not to kill the poor suppliant, and pleaded with him not to kill so small an animal. But the eagle, in wrath, gave the beetle a flap of his wing, and straightaway seized upon the hare and devoured him. When the eagle flew away, the beetle flew after him, to learn where his nest was*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• वाक्य 'D' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक खरगोश" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'D' पहला भाग है।
 
• वाक्य B, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि कैसे भृंग ने बाज से अनुरोध किया कि वह खरगोश को न मारे।
 
• वाक्य A, B के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह बताता है कि बाज ने खरगोश को मारा या नहीं।
 
• वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि जब बाज उड़ गया तो बीटल ने आखिरकार क्या किया।

**Directions: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

“Everything is going to be alright,” said the doctor.

options.text: The doctor said that everything are going to be alright.
The doctor said that everything will be alright.
The doctor said that everything was going to be alright.
The doctor said that everything is going to be alright.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The doctor said that everything was going to be alright**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or converting direct speech into indirect speech:​
 
 
• The commas, inverted commas are removed, and 'that' is added.
 
• The present continuous tense format 'Subject + is + V1 (go) + ing + Object' will be changed into the past continuous tense format 'Subject + was + V1 (go) + ing + Object'.

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes into Indirect speech:
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 Present simple (Subject +V1st + Object)
 Past simple (Subject +V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present continuous (Subject +is/am/are+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Present perfect (Subject + has/have+V3+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past simple (Subject+V2+Object)
 Past perfect (Subject+had+V3+Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous (Subject +was/were+V1+ing+ Object)
 Past perfect continuous (Subject+had been+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 

 Future simple (Subject+ will/shall+V1+object)
 Present Conditional (Subject+would+V1+object)
 
 

 Future Continuous (Subject +will/shall+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 Conditional Continuous (Subject +would+be+V1 +ing+ Object)
 
 
 
 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/876372d5de16ef97d1faa5aea446a2a1925eb0f4b2947737b81766872332b5bd.png] 

 
• दिया गया वाक्य direct speech है।
 
• Direct speech को indirect speech में बदलने या बदलने के लिए बुनियादी नियम:
 
 
• Commas, inverted commas और exclamation mark हटा दिए जाते हैं।
 
• Present continuous tense format 'Subject + is + V1 (go) + ing + Object' को past continuous tense format 'Subject + was + V1 (go) + ing + Object' में बदल दिया जाएगा।

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select ‘No substitution’.**

The toy drummer __plays the drum if you press__ the button at the back.

options.text: will play the drum if you will press
playing the drum if you pressed
played the drum if you are pressing

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'No substitution.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment of the sentence, no correction is required.
 
• The use of the third-person present singular form of the verb 'plays' with the common noun 'toy drummer' is correct.
 
• The use of the definite article 'the' is correctly used before the **specific or known noun 'drum'**.
 
 
• The specific or known noun 'drum' is discussed earlier in ''the toy drummer''.
 
 
 
• The use of the conjunction 'if' is correctly used as it means **when; every time**.
 
• The **non-3rd person singular present form of the verb** 'press' with the **pronoun** 'you' is correct.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *The toy drummer plays the drum if you press the button at the back*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

 
• दिए गए वाक्य के रेखांकित खंड में किसी सुधार की आवश्यकता नहीं है।
 
• Common noun 'toy drummer' के साथ verb 'plays' के third-person present singular form का प्रयोग सही है।
 
• **Definite article 'the'** का प्रयोग **specific or known noun 'drum'** से पहले सही ढंग से किया गया है।
 
 
• Specific or known noun 'drum' की चर्चा वाक्य में पहले ''the toy drummer'' में की गई है।
 
 
 
• Conjunction 'if' का प्रयोग सही ढंग से किया गया है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है **जब भी; हर बार**।
 
• Pronoun 'you' के साथ verb 'press' का non-3rd person singular present form सही है।

 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 है ।

सही वाक्य: *The toy drummer plays the drum if you press the button at the back*.

__
 
• In the given sentence, the use of the simple future tense ''will have'' is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is the third conditional sentence explaining that present circumstances would be different if something different had happened in the past.
 
• The third conditional sentence format: past perfect, modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.)​ + have + past participle.
 
• When using the third conditional, we use the past perfect (i.e., had + past participle) in the if-clause and the modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.) + have + past participle in the main clause.
 
• Therefore, the past form of the verb 'would' should be used in place of the simple future form of the verb 'will'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *Had you not reached in time, **we would have** lost our lives*.

• Third conditional sentence प्रारूप: past perfect, modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.)​ + have + past participle.
 
• Third conditional का उपयोग करते समय, हम if-क्लॉज में past perfect (i.e., had + past participle) का उपयोग करते हैं और modal auxiliary (would, could, should, etc.) + have + past participle, main clause में।
 
• अतः verb 'will' के simple future form के स्थान पर past form of the verb 'would' का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।

 

अतः सही उत्तर option 4 है।

सही वाक्य: *Had you not reached in time, we would have lost our lives*.

• दिया गया वाक्य "*It has a tangy/sour taste and can ___(5)___ your sore throat in a matter of minutes*.'' **पुटका शहद के लाभों का संकेत** दे रहा है।
 
• वाक्य में 'sore' शब्द का प्रयोग **दर्द या पीड़ा** को इंगित करता है।
 
• इसलिए, रिक्त स्थान में भरने के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'soothe' है।
 
• 'Soothe' शब्द का अर्थ है **शरीर के किसी अंग या किसी अनुभूति को कम पीड़ादायक बनाना**।
 
 
• उदाहरण: *Massage can gently soothe away your aches and pains*.
 
 

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 है।
